comment: Level 1 story flow: which lines play, on which trigger, in what order.
notes: Code generated with AI assistance (Claude). Reviewed by team. The words are in story_dialogue.json; this file only refers to them as 'scene.line_id'. 'line_refs_in' lists other data files in which a string '@scene.line_id' is swapped for that line's text at load (Pike's budget refusals, NPC barks, PA calls). OPENING: 'beats' run in order: 'narrate' types one line over the stars, 'stars' fades the star field (alpha 0 = black), 'dialogue' plays lines in the dialogue box ('auto' = seconds each line stays if the player does not press E), 'sfx' plays /assets/audio/<file>.wav, 'title' shows the title card. 'ui' holds dialogue box timings.
